title: predicatory-equalization
description: A predicatory comparison that isolates the equalization locus of two parallel predication-categorical operations: the set of inputs on which their outputs coincide. Generated by specializing comparison to the universal equalizer of parallel arrows, which in the preorder PS collapses, so the live form is the locus Eq(F,G) = { v : F(v) = G(v) } of two operational endomaps together with its complementary defect.

first.description: F, one of the two parallel predication-categorical operations being compared

second.description: G, the other parallel operation sharing F's domain and codomain

agreement-locus.description: Eq(F,G) = { v : F(v) = G(v) }, the locus of inputs where the two operations produce identical outputs

ps-equalizer-collapses.description: in the preorder category PS there is at most one morphism between settlings, so every parallel pair is already equal and the categorical equalizer is just the identity on its domain
